s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic abdominal pain and altered bowel habits with significant weight loss
salient_findings: Recurrent episodes of abdominal pain, bloating, and obstipation
key_facts: Colonoscopy and esophagogastroduodenoscopy showed no abnormalities
Exploratory laparotomy showed no mechanical cause of the obstructions
Alcohol use stopped 2 years ago due to worsening symptoms
CT scan showed small-bowel dilation and megacolon
Gluten-free diet trialed for 3 months produced no improvement

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic abdominal pain and altered bowel habits with significant weight loss
salient_findings: Recurrent episodes of abdominal pain, bloating, and obstipation
key_facts: Colonoscopy and esophagogastroduodenoscopy showed no abnormalities
Exploratory laparotomy showed no mechanical cause of the obstructions
Alcohol use stopped 2 years ago due to worsening symptoms
CT scan showed small-bowel dilation and megacolon
Gluten-free diet trialed for 3 months produced no improvement

shortlist.label: Chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent episodes of abdominal pain, bloating, and obstipation, alternating with intermittent diarrhea, and significant weight loss

shortlist.label: Megacolon
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan showed megacolon dilated up to 15 cm

shortlist.label: Intestinal lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Significant weight loss and altered bowel habits

shortlist.label: Crohn disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic abdominal pain, altered bowel habits, and significant weight loss

shortlist.label: Amyloidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Low levels of fat-soluble vitamins and chronic abdominal symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's 20-year history of recurrent episodes of abdominal pain, bloating, and obstipation, alternating with intermittent diarrhea, and the findings of small-bowel dilation and megacolon on CT scan without a mechanical cause, are consistent with chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction.

rejected.label: Megacolon
rejected.why: While the patient has megacolon, it is likely a consequence of the underlying condition rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Intestinal lymphoma
rejected.why: There is no direct evidence of lymphoma provided in the vignette.

rejected.label: Crohn disease
rejected.why: The colonoscopy and esophagogastroduodenoscopy showed no abnormalities, which makes Crohn disease less likely.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence of amyloidosis provided, such as biopsy results showing amyloid deposits.
